summary: Delta Warp is a 2000 puzzle video game in which the player moves triangular tiles across a board while avoiding hazards such as ice. It was released only in Japan, but it uses English text menus and simple gameplay, so non-Japanese readers can play it.
one_line: Delta Warp is a 2000 Japan-only puzzle video game about moving triangular tiles across a board while avoiding ice.
key_facts: Delta Warp is a puzzle video game released in 2000.
The game involves the player moving triangular shaped tiles across a board.
The player must avoid hazards such as ice while moving the tiles.
Delta Warp was released only in Japan.
Delta Warp features English text menus.
The simple gameplay style means Delta Warp can be played by non-Japanese readers.
